quiz.question: Which state has been honored with the 'Best Agriculture State Award' for 2024 by the 15th Agriculture Leadership Awards Committee?
quiz.explanation: The 15th Agriculture Leadership Awards Committee, chaired by former Chief Justice of India Justice P Sathasivam, honored Maharashtra as the Best Agriculture State for 2024. Chief Minister Eknath Shinde received the award in New Delhi on July 10, 2024. The award recognized Maharashtra's implementation of development policies, agricultural innovations, and its massive bamboo cultivation initiative.

quiz.question: Which state has been named the top-performing state in the 'Best State' category at the 6th National Water Awards 2024 organized by the Union Ministry of Jal Shakti?
quiz.explanation: Maharashtra was named the top-performing state in the 'Best State' category at the 6th National Water Awards 2024, followed by Gujarat and Haryana in second and third places. Telangana emerged as the best-performing state under the 'Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari 1.0' initiative. The awards, organized by the Union Ministry of Jal Shakti, recognize excellence in sustainable water resource practices across India.

quiz.question: Under Maharashtra's flagship 'Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana' launched in July 2024, what is the age group eligible for women to receive the monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500?
quiz.explanation: The Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana was launched by the Government of Maharashtra in July 2024 to promote economic independence, health, and nutrition among women. Under the scheme, eligible women in the age group of 21 to 65 years receive direct financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month. The scheme requires that the family's annual income be less than ₹2.5 lakh and mandatory e-KYC verification.

quiz.question: According to NITI Aayog's draft document 'Vision for Viksit Bharat @ 2047', what is the targeted size of India's economy by the year 2047, the 100th anniversary of its independence?
quiz.explanation: Under the draft vision document 'Vision for Viksit Bharat @ 2047' prepared by NITI Aayog, India aims to become a USD 30 trillion developed economy by 2047. This represents a nearly ninefold increase from the current economic size, with a projected per capita GDP rising to around USD 18,000 to USD 20,000.

quiz.question: Which union department recently launched the 'One DAE One Subscription' (ODOS) initiative at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai to provide comprehensive read and open-access publishing rights to its scientific research papers and journals?
quiz.explanation: The Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) launched the 'One DAE One Subscription' (ODOS) initiative at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai. ODOS is a consortium agreement enabling DAE and all its units (about 60) to access and publish research papers in journals (such as Springer Nature and Wiley) without article processing charges. This initiative will later merge into the national 'One Nation One Subscription' (ONOS) initiative.

quiz.question: Asia's first health research-related 'Pre-clinical Network Facility' under the Coalition of Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) was inaugurated in July 2024 at which of the following Indian institutes?
options: Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), Faridabad
Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai
quiz.explanation: In July 2024, Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated Asia's first health research-related Pre-clinical Network Facility under the Coalition of Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) at BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) in Faridabad, Haryana. It is the 9th such network laboratory globally and the first in Asia, equipped with advanced facilities to handle BSL3 pathogens and accelerate vaccine development.

quiz.question: In the Union Budget 2024-25 presented in July 2024, the Union Government proposed the establishment of which mission to secure the domestic supply, recycling, and overseas acquisition of critical mineral assets?
quiz.explanation: In the Union Budget 2024-25 presented on July 23, 2024, the Union Finance Minister proposed the establishment of a 'Critical Mineral Mission'. Its mandate includes boosting domestic production, facilitating the recycling of critical minerals, and securing overseas acquisition of critical mineral assets. It also emphasizes technology development, building a skilled workforce, and an extended producer responsibility framework.

quiz.question: The Indian Army contingent participated in the multinational military peacekeeping exercise 'KHAAN QUEST 2024' from July 27 to August 9, 2024, at which of the following locations?
quiz.explanation: The Multinational Military Exercise KHAAN QUEST 2024 was conducted from July 27 to August 9, 2024, in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. The Indian Army contingent, consisting of 40 personnel mainly from a Battalion of the MADRAS REGIMENT, participated alongside military forces from over 20 nations to enhance peacekeeping capabilities under Chapter VII of the United Nations Charter.

quiz.question: In the landmark judgment 'Mohd Abdul Samad vs. State of Telangana' delivered in July 2024, the Supreme Court of India upheld that which of the following statutory provisions is religion-neutral and applies to all married women, including divorced Muslim women?
options: Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973
Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), 1860
Section 125 of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872
Section 3 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986
quiz.explanation: On July 10, 2024, a Division Bench of the Supreme Court of India (comprising Justices B.V. Nagarathna and Augustine George Masih) in 'Mohd Abdul Samad vs. State of Telangana' held that Section 125 of the CrPC, 1973 (which deals with a wife's legal right to maintenance) is secular and religion-neutral. The court ruled that the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986 does not prevail over this beneficial provision, and a divorced Muslim woman can claim maintenance from her ex-husband under Section 125 of the CrPC.

quiz.question: In the landmark case 'M.K. Ranjitsinh vs. Union of India', the Supreme Court of India explicitly recognized the 'right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change' as part of which fundamental rights in the Constitution of India?
quiz.explanation: In 'M.K. Ranjitsinh vs. Union of India', a three-judge Bench of the Supreme Court of India (led by Chief Justice D.Y. Chandrachud) explicitly recognized the 'right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change' as a distinct fundamental right. The Court derived this right from Article 21 (Right to Life and Personal Liberty) and Article 14 (Right to Equality), noting that marginalized and vulnerable populations are disproportionately impacted by climate change, thereby violating their right to equality and equal protection under the law.
